changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 4b item 4: moved WorkflowRunStore onto a per-run TransactionalStore<WorkflowRunRecord | null>, inlining the version-mismatch/missing-file-default check that JsonDocumentStore used to run, and moved WorkflowJournal.create onto dreamux-utils' publishFileExclusive. run.ts keeps mutating its working draft before each persistence point; the queue that used to serialize those writes is gone (each run's own TransactionalStore now serializes them), but the reclassification of a failed journal/store write into WorkflowPersistenceError (which executeAgent's catch depends on to tell a storage failure apart from an ordinary agent failure) is preserved under a renamed helper. Named behavior change: WorkflowRun.snapshot(), which backs workflow_status/workflow_list for a live run, now returns the run's last committed (written) value instead of the in-progress in-memory draft between a mutation and the write that persists it. Freshness here was already documented as unspecified, so this narrows rather than changes the contract, but it is a real, observable difference from today's snapshot timing. record.json's shape, the journal's shape, and every public method signature are unchanged. `this.record.x = …` in-place mutation and `AgentCall.record` as a live alias into `this.record.agents[]` were both kept as they were, rather than becoming a pure builder passed to `store.update()` and an index respectively; traced for data loss (each write clones at commit time and every store now serializes on its own `TransactionalStore` queue) and found none.
